title: Cervélo Áspero-5 current platform and builds
notes: Current page classifies Áspero-5 as an aerodynamic gravel-race bike, lists a 45 mm maximum, 42/42 and 40/44 tire strategies, threaded bottom bracket, storage, six sizes and USD 5,500 frameset. Current complete builds range from USD 8,850 to USD 12,650.
